description:
Several small domain helpers have no caller: an item-kind scope parser with its error variant, a closed-state predicate, a label-namespace containment check and a not-in-git-repo error helper.

## Background

- `KindScope::parse` and `parse_for` (`crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:404,409`) and `ItemError::InvalidScope` (`:473`) have no caller. `KindScope::PROJECT_TOKEN` (`:396`) is used only by `parse_for`. `KindScope::ISSUE_TOKEN` (`:394`) stays: production address parsing uses it (`item.rs:233,252,255,258`), and so does `qualified_id` (`:912`).
- `State::is_closed` (`domain/types.rs:64`) has no caller.
- `LabelNamespaces::contains` (`domain/types.rs:3376`, `allow(dead_code)`) has no caller.
- `errors::not_in_git_repo` (`crates/jit/src/errors.rs:1065`) has one caller, its own test (`errors.rs:1280`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `KindScope::parse`, `KindScope::parse_for`, `ItemError::InvalidScope` and `KindScope::PROJECT_TOKEN` no longer exist, and `KindScope::ISSUE_TOKEN` keeps its production callers.
- [hard] REQ-02: `State::is_closed` and `LabelNamespaces::contains` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-03: `errors::not_in_git_repo` and its test no longer exist.

## Notes

Benchmark artifacts under `dev/benchmarks/` that name the deleted test are regenerated evidence and stay.
title: Remove uncalled domain predicates and parsers
